entries.signature: New Colour(red : number, green : number, blue : number) / New Colour(text : string)
entries.description:
A colour as three channels — red, green and blue, each from 0 to 255. A spreadsheet area's BackgroundColour and TextColour hold one, so does a border's Colour, and a form element's BackgroundColour and ForegroundColour take one.

Built from three numbers, or from a text: `"#FF8000"` (a hash and six hex digits), a colour's name (`"orange"`, `"Light Blue"` — the usual web colour names, case and spaces ignored), or `"255,128,0"`. A text that is none of these — an unknown name, a hex of the wrong length — leaves the colour EMPTY rather than refusing: ValueIsFilled answers False and String gives "". In the "r,g,b" form a piece that is not a number from 0 to 255 reads as 0.

Without arguments the colour is empty as well — no colour at all, which is also what an area with no colour of its own answers. One or two numbers are refused ("Error initializing object 'Colour'"). The three numbers are not checked: one above 255 wraps around (256 is 0, 300 is 44), so keep them within 0..255.

String(colour) is its "r,g,b" text, and `New Colour(text)` reads that text back.
entries.parameters:
red, green, blue — the channels, numbers from 0 to 255.
text — "#RRGGBB", a colour's name, or "r,g,b".

entries.description: The red channel, from 0 to 255; read and written. Writing a channel of an EMPTY colour makes it a colour, its other two channels 0. A number above 255 wraps around, as in the constructor.
The green channel, from 0 to 255; read and written. Writing a channel of an EMPTY colour makes it a colour, its other two channels 0. A number above 255 wraps around, as in the constructor.
The blue channel, from 0 to 255; read and written. Writing a channel of an EMPTY colour makes it a colour, its other two channels 0. A number above 255 wraps around, as in the constructor.

entries.signature: New Font(text : string) / New Font(size : number, family : number, style : number, weight : number, underlined : boolean [, face : string])
entries.description:
A font: its size in points, family, style, weight, underline and face. A spreadsheet area's Font holds one, and a form element's Font takes one.

Built from a text or from five or six numbers and values. The text is `face,style,weight,size,family,underlined` — `"Arial,90,700,10,70,0"` is Arial, bold, 10 points — and String(font) gives exactly that text, which `New Font(text)` reads back. The text is read leniently: a piece that is not a number keeps a new font's default, a style, weight or family out of its range reads as the ordinary one.

⚠ THE SIZE IS PART OF THE TEXT. A font of size 0 is no font at all, so `New Font("Arial")` — a face and nothing else — is an EMPTY font: ValueIsFilled answers False and String gives "". Without arguments a font is empty as well.

The second form takes the parts in the order size, family, style, weight, underlined, face (the face may be left out); these numbers are not checked. Two to four arguments are refused ("Error initializing object 'Font'").

A font read from an area is a COPY: change it, then assign it back.
entries.syntax_block:
Font = New Font("Arial,90,700,10,70,0");
Font = New Font(10, 74, 90, 700, False, "Arial");
entries.parameters:
text — `face,style,weight,size,family,underlined`.
size — whole points.
family — 70 default, 71 decorative, 72 roman (serif), 73 script, 74 swiss (sans-serif), 75 modern, 76 teletype (fixed width).
style — 90 normal, 93 italic, 94 slant.
weight — from 100 to 1000: 400 normal, 700 bold.
underlined — True or False.
face — the typeface's name; left out or empty, the family's default face.

entries.description: The size in whole points; read and written. 0 is no font at all — a font whose size is 0 is empty. A fractional number is cut to whole points.

The family, as a number — what the font falls back to when its face is not on the machine: 70 default, 71 decorative, 72 roman (serif), 73 script, 74 swiss (sans-serif), 75 modern, 76 teletype (fixed width). Read and written; the property takes the number as given, while the text form reads a number outside 70..76 as 70.
The style, as a number: 90 normal, 93 italic, 94 slant. Read and written; the property takes the number as given, while the text form reads any other number as 90.

The weight, as a number from 100 to 1000: 100 thin, 300 light, 400 normal, 500 medium, 600 semibold, 700 bold, 800 extra bold, 900 heavy; a weight between them is a weight too. Read and written. The text form reads a weight below 400 or of 1000 and over as 400 — write a light weight through the property.
Whether the text is underlined; read and written.
The typeface's name — "Arial", "Courier New". Empty: the default face of the font's family. Read and written. A face the machine that draws the text does not have falls back to its family.

entries.signature: New Point(left : number, top : number) / New Point(text : string)
entries.description:
A position in pixels: Left and Top, whole numbers.

Built from two numbers or from the text `"left,top"`. Without arguments — or from a text that is not two whole numbers split by a comma — it is (-1, -1), the position that says "none": ValueIsFilled answers False for it. A single number is refused ("Error initializing object 'Point'").

String(point) is its "left,top" text.
entries.syntax_block:
Point = New Point(10, 20);
Point = New Point("10,20");
entries.parameters:
left, top — whole numbers, in pixels.
text — "left,top".

entries.description: The horizontal position, in pixels; read and written. A fractional number is cut to a whole one.
The vertical position, in pixels; read and written. A fractional number is cut to a whole one.

entries.signature: New Size(width : number, height : number) / New Size(text : string)
entries.description:
A width and a height, whole numbers. A spreadsheet area's Size holds one; a form element's MinimumSize and MaximumSize take one.

Built from two numbers or from the text `"width,height"`. Without arguments — or from a text that is not two whole numbers split by a comma — it is (-1, -1), the size that says "none" ("not set" for a form element's limit): ValueIsFilled answers False for it. A single number is refused ("Error initializing object 'Size'").

A size read from an area is a COPY: change it, then assign it back. String(size) is its "width,height" text.
entries.syntax_block:
Size = New Size(300, 200);
Size = New Size("300,200");

entries.description: The width; read and written. A fractional number is cut to a whole one; -1 is "not set".
The height; read and written. A fractional number is cut to a whole one; -1 is "not set".

A picture held as its own bytes, read from a PNG file. It is what a form element's Picture property takes and what a value list item's picture holds.

The file is read ONCE, when the value is made, on the machine the script runs on (the server, for server code); afterwards the picture does not depend on the file. A path that names no file, an empty file, and a file that is not a PNG picture — a JPEG or a BMP included — are refused ("Error initializing object 'StoragePicture'").

Without arguments the picture is empty: ValueIsFilled answers False. A picture has no properties or methods of its own.
entries.parameters: path — the PNG file to read.
